evidence_class: prospective independent three-wave temporal confirmatory test

primary.estimand: equal-weight mean across estimable heldout MF taxa of within-taxon binary logloss(C)-binary logloss(R2)
primary.candidate_addition: target-specific pre-loss lost-access fraction E_i only

secondary_nonrescuing.interpretation: some descriptive direction is compatible with higher lost-access fraction among later contractions, but the heldout taxon-macro primary did not improve and secondary summaries may not rescue it

scientific_interpretation.supported: BALA provides an independent prospective three-wave test in which source-loss exposure precedes later occupancy contraction and all 20 heldout taxon folds are estimable.
scientific_interpretation.not_supported: Target-specific lost-source access fraction did not add generalizable heldout predictive information beyond source counts, remaining-source geometry, island identity and survey effort.
scientific_interpretation.conservation_consequence: Cross-sectional source leverage from the global mammal system is not validated as a general conservation-prioritization metric by this independent temporal test.
